name: v1rus-typescript
description: The TypeScript language and toolchain layer shared by every v1rus TypeScript project, backend and web alike: tsconfig strictness beyond `strict` plus ESM and module resolution, type modelling that makes illegal states unrepresentable (discriminated unions, exhaustive switches with a never guard, satisfies, branded ids, generics that earn their place), runtime schema validation at every I/O boundary because a type from JSON.parse is a lie, Error subclasses with cause and the Result-versus-throw line, floating promises and concurrency and AbortSignal propagation, package exports maps and the real cost of barrel files, and a type-aware ESLint flat-config gate with reasoned disables.
